## Interpretation

The all-beta spin phi(d) table includes the complexity-nearest spin beta, but the closest phi(d) curve is a different beta. The complexity-nearest beta is rank 9 by phi(d) RMSE, with 10.574x the best RMSE. That is evidence that the scalar roughness complexity is not sufficient on its own for the local energy landscape measured by phi(d), unless the rank/ratio gap is small enough to be practically negligible.
